evidence: Changes the bitcoinkernel C API log callbacks and implements KernelLogger to remove node logging dependencies from the kernel build.
rationale: Decoupling node logging machinery from the kernel library advances the core project goal of removing node dependencies from kernel code. External consumers gain structured log entries via `btck_LogEntry` rather than brittle string parsing, and dropping `logging.cpp` from the kernel unblocks dependent decoupling work (#30342, #33847).
